label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark, read by screen readers.

collapsed.description: Whether the rail is collapsed, a state that the app updates in `onCollapse`.

onCollapse.description: Called when the user clicks the collapse button, with the new `collapsed` value.

collapseLabel.description: Screen reader text and tooltip of the collapse button when the rail is expanded.

expandLabel.description: Screen reader text and tooltip of the collapse button when the rail is collapsed.

backLabel.description: Screen reader text of the back button in a deeper SubNav level.

closeSubNavLabel.description: Screen reader text of the handle that closes the open SubNav.

openSubNav.description: The `itemID` of the item or account whose SubNav is open, or `undefined` when none is open.

onSubNavChange.description: Called when the user opens or closes a SubNav, with the `itemID` of the item or `undefined`.
